name: TC-2.1: Verify Effective Permission Union formula across Primary + Supportive + Direct Permissions
fullName: TC-2.1: Verify Effective Permission Union formula across Primary + Supportive + Direct Permissions

steps.name:
task db:executeQuery, {query: 
        SELECT p.name AS permission_name, 'Primary Role' AS source
        FROM model_has_roles mhr
        JOIN role_has_permissions rhp ON rhp.role_id = mhr.role_id
        JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rhp.permission_id
        WHERE mhr.model_type = ? AND mhr.model_id = ? AND mhr.is_primary = 1

        UNION

        SELECT p.name AS permission_name, 'Supportive Role' AS source
        FROM model_has_roles mhr
        JOIN role_has_permissions rhp ON rhp.role_id = mhr.role_id
        JOIN permissions p ON p.id = rhp.permission_id
        WHERE mhr.model_type = ? AND mhr.model_id = ? AND mhr.is_primary = 0

        UNION

        SELECT p.name AS permission_name, 'Direct User Permission' AS source
        FROM model_has_permissions mhp
        JOIN permissions p ON p.id = mhp.permission_id
        WHERE mhp.model_type = ? AND mhp.model_id = ?;
      , params: Array[6]}
